title: $300 Million Gone in 268 Days #shorts
description:
Pets.com went public in February two thousand with a famous sock puppet and a Super Bowl ad. Two hundred sixty-eight days later it shut down.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Bad idea, or just too early? Would Pets.com work today? 👇

lines.text: Three hundred million dollars, gone in two hundred sixty-eight days.
For a company that sold pet food online.
Pets dot com had a sock puppet mascot and a Super Bowl ad.
In February two thousand, it went public and raised over eighty million dollars.
But it sold heavy bags of food for less than they cost to ship.
In November two thousand, Pets dot com shut down.
Just two hundred sixty-eight days after going public.
Three hundred million dollars, lost shipping dog food.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
